newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes up, reels in crude earlier gain.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes up, reels in crude earlier gain.

text.p: IPE gas oil closed sharply higher on Thursday having played catch-up to crude's late gains on Wednesday.
The February contract closed up $5.25 at $219.00 a tonne, only 25 cents off the day's high.
"It looked stronger for most of the day," commented one trader.

Forecasts of cold weather in the northeastern United States, the world's key market for heating oil, gave some fundamental support. Snow storms whipping along the U.S. midwest are heading eastwards and the northeast is in for a chilly weekend.
IPE March Brent hovered in a narrow range in the afternoon and was trading at $23.26 a barrel at 1800 GMT, down 39 cents with the mood one of consolidation.
"It was very sharp (the late gain) yesterday and I think everyone is a bit calmer today," said one trader.
The February contract, which expires at close of business today, was down 29 cents but was "in a world of its own," according to one broker. Most positions had been cleared by mid-afternoon.
